test_title: PYST 60: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Contribution".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The contribution word means something that you give or donate.
 
• So, technology's biggest contribution is the development of the internet.
 
• **Example - ***All contributions should be appreciated.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Supply **means the amount of something that is provided to be used.

 
 
• **Example: ***Food was supplied by helicopters during a flood.*
 
 
 
• **Value **means something which is important or the amount of money that something is worth.
 
 
• **Example: ***I really value her as a friend.*
 
 
 
• **Hindrance **means a person or a thing that makes it difficult for you to do something
 
 
• **Example - ***She creates hindrances wherever she goes.*
